Because you have only space for at most one extra order (capacity 2) and the extra delivery always “comes for free” in terms of delivery distance once on board, your overall profit will be:

sentence: Summary Answer

sentence: The optimal route for a carrier who has just picked up the original order with capacity for one extra order is to deliver to the common destination by following the shortest (least–distance) route.
